solution:
Since $\cot\theta=1/\tan\theta$ (for $\tan\theta\neq0$),
$$\tan\theta+\frac{1}{\tan\theta}=2\quad\Rightarrow\quad \frac{\tan^2\theta+1}{\tan\theta}=2\quad\Rightarrow\quad \tan^2\theta-2\tan\theta+1=0.$$
Thus $(\tan\theta-1)^2=0$, so $\tan\theta=1$. In $(0,\pi)$ this gives $\theta=\tfrac{\pi}{4}$.
